children.text: अथ श्रीशिवविवाह ।।
children.translated_text: Now [begins] the Sacred Marriage of <s>Śiva</s>.

children.text: दो० ।नमो युगल पंकजचरण, श्रीगणपति शिरनाइ।
कहौं काथा शुभब्याहशिव, छन्दकवित्त वनाह।।
children.translated_text: I tell the tale of the auspicious marriage of <s>Śiva</s>, in verse and poetry.

children.text: सवैया ।। कण्ठबिराजत जाहि हलाहल,
children.translated_text: Savaiyā: On whose throat the <s>hālāhala</s> (poison) gleams,

children.text: शीश धरे सित गंग की धारा । बाम शिवा
children.translated_text: who bears the stream of the white <s>Gaṅgā</s> on his head; on his left is <s>Śivā</s>,

children.text: अरधंगिनि जो,कटिशार्दुलचर्म कसे अहि-
children.translated_text: his half-bodied consort; around his waist a tiger-skin is tied, with serpent-

children.text: डाँरा ।। भस्मसुअंग ललाटशशी, कर शूल
children.translated_text: girdle. Ash adorning his body, the moon on his brow, a trident

children.text: धरे बसहा असवारा ।सो शिव मोपर होहु
children.translated_text: in his hand, riding the bull — may that <s>Śiva</s> be

children.text: दयाल, नमो चरणाम्बुज बारहिंबारा १ ।।
children.translated_text: merciful to me; I bow to his lotus-feet again and again. 1.

children.text: धनाक्षरी।। शङ्कर के ब्याहकी भईहै तइयारी
children.translated_text: Ghanākṣarī: When the preparations for <s>Śaṅkara</s>'s wedding were made,

children.text: जब, गण सब दुल्लह शृँगार शिव करहीं ।
children.translated_text: all the <s>gaṇa</s>s adorned <s>Śiva</s> as the bridegroom.

children.text: माथेजटामुकुटभुजंगनकोमौरगूथि; कुण्डल
children.translated_text: On his head a crown of matted locks, serpents threaded [through]; ear-rings

children.text: कानन पहिराये बिषधरहीं ।। होथे ब्याल
children.translated_text: of venomous snakes placed upon his ears.

children.text: कङ्कण बिभूति सर्बअंगन में, शशिभाल
children.translated_text: Snake-bracelets on his arms, sacred ash on all his limbs, moon

children.text: शशि गङ्गा सोहत सुँदरहीं। कांधे उपबीत
children.translated_text: on his brow, <s>Gaṅgā</s> and moon shining beautifully. On his shoulder a sacred-thread

children.text: सर्पनैनतीनबिषकण्ठ,डालेगलेबीचमाला
children.translated_text: of serpents, three-eyed, poison-throated, around his neck a garland

children.text: गूथी नरशिरहीं १ दुल्लह स्वरूप बनि
children.translated_text: strung of human skulls. 1. Having thus become the bridegroom in form,

children.text: चढ़िशिव बसहापै, साजिके समाज निज
children.translated_text: <s>Śiva</s> mounted his bull, and having assembled his retinue,

children.text: चले ले बराति जो।अमितप्रकार गण बेषहुँ
children.translated_text: set out leading the wedding procession. Innumerable <s>gaṇa</s>s in many guises,

children.text: अनेक बिधि, निज निज बाहन चढ़े हैं बहु
children.translated_text: each mounted on their own steeds in many

children.text: भाँति जो ।। खर श्वान असुर शृगाल बाघ
children.translated_text: ways. Donkeys, dogs, demons, jackals, tigers,

children.text: मूषगण,बिबिध स्वरूप सब अगणित जाति
children.translated_text: mice — of diverse forms, all of countless species.

children.text: जो। भूत प्रेत योगिनी पिशाच बहुरंगनको,
children.translated_text: Ghosts, spirits, <s>yoginī</s>s, <s>piśāca</s>s of many colors —

children.text: चले सब हरषित सकलजमाति जो२ वि-
children.translated_text: all set forth joyfully with the entire company. 2. Fierce

children.text: कट सरूप बिकराल रुद्रगण जेते, अदभुत
children.translated_text: in form, terrible — all the <s>Rudra</s>-<s>gaṇa</s>s — a wondrous

children.text: शोभा नहिं बनत बखानते। काहू अंग मुख-
children.translated_text: splendor beyond description. Some without faces or limbs,

children.text: हीन काहू अति पुष्ट पीन, कोउ कृशगात
children.translated_text: some exceedingly fat and stout, some thin of body,

children.text: छीन कोउ हीन कानते।। काहू कर पद नाहीं
children.translated_text: emaciated, some without ears. Some without hands or feet,

children.text: काहू बहुपगबाहीं, कोउ बिनु शीश धाहीं
children.translated_text: some with many legs and arms, some headless, rushing about,

children.text: नाचरंग ठानते । काहू को बिपुल नैन काहू
children.translated_text: staging their dancing displays. Some with enormous eyes, some

children.text: को एक हुहैन,कोउ बहुमुख बैनगावतसता-
children.translated_text: with not even one eye, some with many mouths, singing continually.

children.text: नते ३ मगबीच चलेजात परम तरङ्गी सब,
children.translated_text: 3. On the road they all went in the highest excitement —

children.text: भूत प्रेत योगिनी पिशाच बहुभावते । हँसत
children.translated_text: ghosts, spirits, <s>yoginī</s>s, <s>piśāca</s>s in many moods, laughing,

children.text: खेलत बहु करत तमाशा मिलि, बिबिध
children.translated_text: playing, making a great spectacle together, playing

children.text: बजाइ बाजा नाचि नाचि गावते।। अङ्गन में
children.translated_text: various instruments, dancing and singing. On their bodies

children.text: भूषण अनेक भाँति बिकराल,गले में कपाल
children.translated_text: ornaments of many terrifying kinds, around their necks skull-

children.text: माल शोणित चूआवते । अतिही अपा-
children.translated_text: garlands dripping blood. Utterly

children.text: वन डरावन सरूप सब, कूदतफांदत पंथ
children.translated_text: impure and frightful in form, all of them, leaping and bounding along the path,

children.text: चलतहैं धावते ४ हरि बिधि और हुँ सकल
children.translated_text: running as they went. 4. <s>Hari</s>, <s>Brahmā</s>, and all the other

children.text: देव दिशिराज, साजिके समाज निज बहुत
children.translated_text: gods and the guardians of the directions, having assembled their own retinues in many

children.text: प्रकारहीं । चढ़ि चढ़ि बाहनन बिलगबिलग
children.translated_text: ways, mounting their various steeds in separate

children.text: वृन्द,चले हैं बरात चित्त हरष अपारहीं ।।
children.translated_text: groups, set out for the wedding, their hearts filled with boundless joy.

children.text: मगु महँ कौतुक अनेक बिधि होत जात,
children.translated_text: Along the road, merriment of many kinds arose,

children.text: शिवको समाज लखि हँसें बारबारहीं । सुर-
children.translated_text: and seeing <s>Śiva</s>'s retinue, they laughed again and again. The divine

children.text: तियशस्भुहिंबिलोकि के कहति हँसि, दुल्लह
children.translated_text: ladies, looking down from the sky, said laughingly: "Suited to the bridegroom —

children.text: के योग्य दुलहिनि न संसारहीं ५ इत हिम-
children.translated_text: there is no [fitting] bride in the world!" 5. Meanwhile, in <s>Himālaya</s>'s

children.text: गिरि निज नगर में नाना भाँति, अतिही
children.translated_text: own city, in many ways, most

children.text: बिचित्र सुबितान रचवाये हैं । घर घर
children.translated_text: elaborate and fine wedding-canopies were erected. In every house

children.text: तोरण पताका ध्वजर रङ्गराङ्ग, मण्डप अनेक
children.translated_text: arches, banners, flags of many colors, pavilions of many

children.text: भाँति शुचि बनवाये हैं ।। बनबाग उपबन
children.translated_text: kinds, pure and well-made. Gardens, groves, sub-gardens,

children.text: बापिकातङागकूप,सुन्दरअनूपरम्भाथम्भ
children.translated_text: step-wells, tanks, wells — beautiful, matchless pillars

children.text: लगवाये हैं । जहां तहां गृह बहु राखे सँव-
children.translated_text: were erected. Here and there, many houses were well

children.text: राइ भल, सजल हाटक घट द्वार धरवाये
children.translated_text: decorated, and golden water-pots placed at the doors.

children.text: हैं ६ सकल जगतमहँ लघु औ बिशाल
children.translated_text: 6. All the mountains in the world, small and great,

children.text: शैल, सागर तलाव नद नदी बन जितनै ।
children.translated_text: oceans, lakes, rivers, streams, and forests — as many as there were —

children.text: सब कहँ हिमवन्त नेवता पठाइ दिये,
children.translated_text: to all of them <s>Himavān</s> sent invitations;

children.text: सुनत चले हैं हरषित सब तितनै ।। सुन्दर
children.translated_text: hearing [the news], all of them set out joyfully. Beautiful,

children.text: सुहावन समाज निज लेइ लेइ, नारिन स-
children.translated_text: delightful retinues, each bringing their own, women

children.text: हित तन धरि धरि कितनै । पहुँचे हिमाचल
children.translated_text: included, taking bodily forms, so many. They all arrived

children.text: नगर माहँ आइ सब, टिके यथायोग्य ठौर
children.translated_text: in <s>Himācala</s>'s city and were lodged in their proper

children.text: ठौर जाको मितनै ७ उतते बरात आइ
children.translated_text: places, each according to their station. 7. From that side, the wedding procession arrived

children.text: पहुँची नगर पास,सुनि पुरबासी लोग हिये
children.translated_text: near the city, and hearing [the news], the townspeople were

children.text: हरषाइ जो । हाथी घोड़ा ऊंट रथ आदिक
children.translated_text: delighted. Elephants, horses, camels, chariots, and many other

children.text: अनेक भांति, सजि सजि बाहनन शोभा
children.translated_text: kinds [of conveyances], adorning them well, their splendor

children.text: अधिकाइ जो ।। चले लेन अगुवान सादर
children.translated_text: greatly increased. All went together respectfully to receive

children.text: सकलमिलि, आनँद उछाह मन बरणी न
children.translated_text: the [groom's] welcoming party — the joy and enthusiasm of their hearts beyond

children.text: जाइजो । देवन समाज लखि मुदित हृदय
children.translated_text: description. Seeing the gods' retinue, all were glad at heart;

children.text: सब, हरिहिं बिलोकी अति आनँद हू छाइ
children.translated_text: seeing <s>Hari</s>, they were enveloped in supreme

children.text: जो ८ शिवको समाज अवलोके पुरलोगन
children.translated_text: bliss. 8. When the townspeople beheld <s>Śiva</s>'s

children.text: जो, देखत चकित सब परमभयावनै । कहुँ
children.translated_text: retinue, they were astonished — all extremely terrified. Everywhere

children.text: भूत प्रेतगण कहुँ बाघ ब्याल कहुँ, निशि-
children.translated_text: ghosts and spirits, everywhere tigers and serpents, everywhere night-

children.text: चर बिकट सरूप जो अपावनै ।। देखतहिं
children.translated_text: stalkers of hideous, impure form. Upon seeing

children.text: बाहनबिडरि सब भागिचले,कहुँ हाथी कहुँ
children.translated_text: them, all the [riding] animals panicked and fled — some elephants, some

children.text: घोड़ा प्राणको बचावनै । बालक सकलडरि
children.translated_text: horses, [all] saving their lives. All the children, frightened,

children.text: भागिगये घरघर, रहे धीर धरि स्यान गये
children.translated_text: ran off to their homes; the wise elders, keeping their composure, went

children.text: जो बुलावनै ९ पूछत धरन पितु मातु सब
children.translated_text: to call [them back]. 9. Fathers and mothers caught hold of each child

children.text: बालकहिं, कम्पितशरीर भययुत बैन क-
children.translated_text: and asked [what happened]; trembling, fear-stricken, they

children.text: हहीं । हालकौन पूछतहौ कहत बनै न कछु,
children.translated_text: spoke. "What situation are you asking about? Nothing can be said —

children.text: है सो बरिआत किधों यमधार अहहीं ।।
children.translated_text: is this a wedding procession, or the army of <s>Yama</s>?

children.text: भूत प्रेत योगिनी पिशाचगण निशिचर,
children.translated_text: Ghosts, spirits, <s>yoginī</s>s, <s>piśāca</s>s, <s>gaṇa</s>s, and night-stalkers —

children.text: डाले गले मुण्डमाल नाचें जहां तहँहीं ।
children.translated_text: skull-garlands hanging around their necks, dancing everywhere.

children.text: बाघ सिंह खर श्वान भुजग भयावन जो,
children.translated_text: Tigers, lions, donkeys, dogs, serpents — how frightful!

children.text: घनिभाग वाके देखि जीवत जो रहहीं १०
children.translated_text: Greatly fortunate are those who remain alive after seeing them!" 10.

children.text: बर बउराह सब अंगन लगाये छार, कंकन
children.translated_text: "The bridegroom is a madman, ash smeared on every limb, bracelets

children.text: भुजंगकर कुण्डल हुँ ब्याल हैं । सर्पको जनेउ
children.translated_text: of serpents, earrings also of snakes. A sacred-thread of serpents

children.text: कांधे माथ हुँ में नागबांधे, देखत भयावन
children.translated_text: on his shoulder, snakes tied upon his head — frightful to behold —

children.text: गले में मुण्डमाल हैं ।। बस्त्र तन बाघ-
children.translated_text: a skull-garland around his neck. His garment is a tiger-

children.text: छाला कटिकसे अहिकाला,गङ्गशीश चन्द्र-
children.translated_text: skin, a black snake tied at his waist, <s>Gaṅgā</s> on his head, moon

children.text: भाल नैन लाल लाल हैं । कहैं अस
children.translated_text: on his brow, eyes red, red." All the children thus

children.text: सब बाल निज निज घर हाल, दुल्लह
children.translated_text: told their homes the situation — "The bridegroom's

children.text: स्वरूप तो बड़ाहि बिकराल हैं ११
children.translated_text: form is exceedingly terrible!" 11.

children.text: जननी जनक सब बालकन बैन सुनि,
children.translated_text: Hearing all the children's words, mothers and fathers,

children.text: शङ्कर समाज हाल बूझि मुसुकाइकै ।
children.translated_text: having inquired about the state of <s>Śaṅkara</s>'s retinue, smiled.

children.text: कह्यो सो बहुत बिधि बालकहिं समुझाइ,
children.translated_text: They reassured the children in many ways:

children.text: निडररहहु सबभय बिसराइकै ।। सुनिमातु
children.translated_text: "Be fearless, all — forget your fear!" Hearing their mothers'

children.text: पितुवानी धीरज लहे सो बाल, करि अगु-
children.translated_text: and fathers' words, the children took courage, and the welcoming

children.text: वान लोग फिरे सब आइकै । सुन्दर सुहा-
children.translated_text: party, [having completed their duties], all returned. In a beautiful,

children.text: वन सुपावन जो ठौर तहाँ, जनवास दिये
children.translated_text: pleasant, and pure place, the wedding guests' quarters were provided,

children.text: हैं बरातहिं लिवाइकै १२ दुल्लहको परि-
children.translated_text: having brought the wedding party there. 12. For the inspection of the bridegroom

children.text: छन हेतु बहु भाँतिनको, साजिके मङ्गल
children.translated_text: in many ways, <s>Mainā</s>, having prepared the auspicious

children.text: साज मैना हरषाइकै । साथ बहु सुन्दरि
children.translated_text: items, was delighted. With many beautiful, fortunate women, adorned

children.text: सोहागिनी शृङ्गार करि, भूषण बसन भल
children.translated_text: and ornamented, dressed well in fine garments and jewels,

children.text: अङ्गनसजाइकै ।। दूब दधि रोचन अक्षत पान
children.translated_text: bearing [items for the ceremony]. <s>Dūrvā</s> grass, curds, <s>rocana</s> (saffron), unbroken rice, betel, flowers, lamps —

children.text: पुष्प दीप, धरि हेमथारनसुमङ्गल रचाइकै ।
children.translated_text: placed on golden trays, the auspicious preparations were made.

children.text: चलीं लेइ गीतशुभ गावती सुराग धरि,
children.translated_text: They set out singing auspicious songs in lovely melodies,

children.text: सब पिकबैनी मन आनँद बढ़ाइकै १३
children.translated_text: all the sweet-voiced [women], increasing the joy in their hearts. 13.

children.text: बरके समीप जाइ पहुँची सुन्दरि जब,
children.translated_text: When the beautiful [women] approached the bridegroom,

children.text: बिकट स्वरूप लखि शोच उर छाइगै ।
children.translated_text: seeing his hideous form, sorrow filled their hearts.

children.text: व्याकुल शंकित होइ भागि भागि चलीं
children.translated_text: Agitated and alarmed, they fled back

children.text: घर, तनकर सुधि सब काहुहिं भुलाइगै ।।
children.translated_text: home — all awareness of themselves forgotten.

children.text: भूषण खसत कहुँ हारहुँ टूटत कहुँ, बसन
children.translated_text: Ornaments falling here, necklaces breaking there, garments

children.text: भारी, आारति करति नारीशिहितकारिकै ।
children.translated_text: heavy in their hearts, the women perform the <s>āratī</s> (lamp-waving ceremony) for his welfare.

children.text: गावतीं मधुरगीत प्रमुदित सहप्रीत, करति
children.translated_text: They sing sweet songs, overflowing with delight and love, performing

children.text: मंगल रीति बिबिध प्रकारिकै । बाजन अ-
children.translated_text: auspicious rites of various kinds.

children.text: नेकढंग बाजत बहुतरंग, सुनत उमंगअंग
children.translated_text: Instruments of many sorts play with great exuberance; hearing them, waves of joy

children.text: होतनरनारिकै ३१ गिरिजाहिं मुनिन बुलाइ
children.translated_text: arise in the bodies of men and women. 31. <s>Girijā</s> (Pārvatī) was summoned by the sages and

children.text: पठये हैं तब, सखिन शृंगारसाज बिबिध
children.translated_text: sent [to the pavilion]; her friends adorning her with

children.text: सजाइकै । अंग अंग भूषण मणिन नगज-
children.translated_text: various ornamental arrays. Ornaments on every limb, set with

children.text: टित जो, बसन बिचित्र यथोचित पहिरा-
children.translated_text: gems and jewels, clothed in wondrous garments as befitting,

children.text: इकै ।। सकल मनोहर शृंगार नव सप्तकरि,
children.translated_text: having been dressed. All enchanting adornments, the nine new decorations applied,

children.text: गावति मंगलगीत सखि हरषाइकै । ल्याइ
children.translated_text: the friends sing auspicious songs with delight.

children.text: हैं उमाहिं जहां मण्डपअमर मनि, छबिसों
children.translated_text: They bring <s>Umā</s> to the pavilion, the abode of the immortals — who can describe

children.text: जगत मातु कहे कौन गाइकै ३२ देवगण
children.translated_text: the splendor of the Mother of the World? 32. The assembly of gods,

children.text: गिरिजाहिं देखिके मनहिं मन, जानि भव
children.translated_text: seeing <s>Girijā</s>, [thinking] in their minds, recognizing her as

children.text: बामा जु प्रणाम सब किये हैं । तब मुनि
children.translated_text: the consort of <s>Bhava</s> (<s>Śiva</s>), all made obeisance. Then, by the command

children.text: आयसु भवानी मध्य मण्डप के, गवनी हैं
children.translated_text: of the sages, <s>Bhavānī</s> proceeded to the center of the pavilion,

children.text: जहां शिव प्राणपति प्रियेहैं ।। पतिपदपं-
children.translated_text: where <s>Śiva</s>, the lord of her life, her beloved, was seated.

children.text: कजमें मधुकर मन बस्यो, सकति बिलोकि
children.translated_text: Like a bee absorbed in the lotus of her husband's feet,

children.text: न सकोच अति हिये हैं । लोक कुललाज
children.translated_text: she cannot look [at him], so great is the shyness in her heart.

children.text: स्वइ भयोहै बियोग निशा, थकित चकई
children.translated_text: The modesty of family and custom has itself become the night of separation;

children.text: दृग प्रीति बरजिये हैं ३३ पाइ अनुशासन
children.translated_text: the weary eyes, like the <s>cakavā</s> bird, have restrained love. 33. Receiving the instructions

children.text: मुनीशनको शिवशिवा, पूजेहैं अनादि देव
children.translated_text: of the great sages, <s>Śiva</s> and <s>Śivā</s> worship the primordial god

children.text: गणपति प्रीतिसो । जस कछु ब्याह को
children.translated_text: <s>Gaṇapati</s> with love. Whatever Vedic rites

children.text: बिधान बेदबरणन, मुनिन कराये तस स-
children.translated_text: are prescribed for marriage,

children.text: कल सुरीतिसो ।। मुदित गिरीश तब गहि
children.translated_text: the sages performed them all with proper ceremony.

children.text: कुश कन्यापाणि, शंभुहिं समर्पे करि बिधि
children.translated_text: Then the joyful Mountain-Lord (<s>Girīśa</s>), holding <s>kuśa</s> grass and the bride's hand,

children.text: जस नीतिसो । सुन्दरि सकल कलबैन
children.translated_text: presented [her] to <s>Śambhu</s>, performing the rite as prescribed.

children.text: शुभ गीत गावें, अतिही उछाह उर कहे
children.translated_text: Beautiful women sing auspicious songs and melodious words;

children.text: कौन मीतिसो ३४ जब पाणिग्रहण उमा
children.translated_text: such overwhelming delight in the heart — who can measure it? 34. When <s>Śaṅkara</s>

children.text: को किये शङ्करजू, आनँद अधिक भयो
children.translated_text: performed the taking of <s>Umā</s>'s hand (<s>pāṇigrahaṇa</s>),

children.text: हृदय अमरहीं । बारबार मुदित कहत सब
children.translated_text: great joy arose in the hearts of the immortals.

children.text: जयजय, मुनिनहरषि बेदमन्त्र सुउचरहीं ।।
children.translated_text: Again and again, all joyfully exclaim 'Victory! Victory!' The sages happily chant Vedic <s>mantras</s>.

children.text: सुमन अनेक भाँति गगन ते वृष्टि होत,
children.translated_text: Flowers of many kinds shower from the sky,

children.text: सानँद भूदेव बहु शङ्खधुनि करहीं ।
children.translated_text: the joyful <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> blow many conch shells.

children.text: बाजन बिबिध बिधि बाजत सुहावन जो,
children.translated_text: Instruments of various kinds play delightfully;

children.text: परम आनन्द भयो ब्याह उमा हरहीं ३५
children.translated_text: supreme joy arose at the wedding of <s>Umā</s> and <s>Hara</s>. 35.

children.text: दाइज अनेक भांति दीन्ह हिमगिरि केते,
children.translated_text: Dowry of many kinds was given by <s>Himagiri</s> (the Himalaya) — how many!

children.text: गज बाज बाहन बिबिध रंग जाति जो ।
children.translated_text: Elephants, horses, vehicles of various colors and breeds,

children.text: दास दासी धेनु बहुक्षीरदेनिहारी जौन,करि
children.translated_text: male and female servants, many cows yielding abundant milk, elephants

children.text: अलंकृतसह बत्सन सुहाति जो ।। भूषण
children.translated_text: decorated, with calves, most pleasing. Ornaments,

children.text: बसन मणि बस्तु बर मोलनको, कनक
children.translated_text: garments, gems, fine goods of great value,

children.text: भाजनभरि अन्न बहु भांति जो । सुन्दर
children.translated_text: golden vessels filled with grain of many kinds.

children.text: सकल बिधि अगणित बस्तु सब, दिये हैं
children.translated_text: Beautiful [gifts] of every sort, innumerable items, all

children.text: बखानि कछु लेखा न कहाति जो ३६ कर
children.translated_text: given — described even partially, the count cannot be told. 36. With folded

children.text: जोरि बिनती करत गिरि शंकर सों, तमहीं
children.translated_text: hands, the Mountain [Lord] entreats <s>Śaṅkara</s>: 'What can

children.text: मैं देउँ कहा शिव भगवानजू । तुमतौ औ-
children.translated_text: I give to you, O Lord <s>Śiva</s>, O Blessed One?

children.text: ढरदानि सकल पूरणकाम, तुम्हारे न योग्य
children.translated_text: You are the generous giver of all, the fulfiller of all desires; I am

children.text: मैंहौं करुणानिधान जू ।। मोहिंपर राखब
children.translated_text: not worthy of you, O treasury of compassion.

children.text: कृपाल अब छोह नित, कहि अस गहे पद-
children.translated_text: Keep your grace upon me always, O merciful one' — saying thus, he grasped the lotus feet, O mine of happiness.

children.text: कञ्ज सुखखानजू । करुणाभवन हर सुनि
children.translated_text: <s>Hara</s> (<s>Śiva</s>), the abode of compassion, hearing the words of his father-in-law,

children.text: बैन ससुरको; कीन्ह बहुबिधि परितोष सन-
children.translated_text: honored and consoled him in many ways,

children.text: मानजू ३७ गहि पदपंकज सुप्रेम पुलकित
children.translated_text: with respect. 37. Grasping his lotus feet, with love and a thrilled

children.text: हिये, कहती निहोरि मैना करुणा बचनजू ।
children.translated_text: heart, <s>Mainā</s> (the Mountain's wife) speaks entreating, with compassionate words.

children.text: नाथ यह उमा मम अहईजु प्राणसम, जानि
children.translated_text: 'Lord, this <s>Umā</s> is as dear to me as my very life; knowing

children.text: निज दासी याहि राखब सदनजु ।। क्षमि
children.translated_text: her as your own servant, keep her in your home.

children.text: अपराध सब करि दया यहिपर, दीजै बर-
children.translated_text: Forgiving all faults, showing mercy upon her,

children.text: दान अब करुणायतनजू । याहिबिधि सुनि
children.translated_text: grant this boon now, O abode of compassion.'

children.text: शिव सासुको बिनय बहु, समुझायो गइ
children.translated_text: Thus hearing the many entreaties of <s>Śiva</s>'s mother-in-law,

children.text: शिरनाइ सो भवनजू ३८ गिरिजाहिं जननी
children.translated_text: [she] was consoled; she bowed her head and went to her quarters. 38. <s>Girijā</s>'s mother

children.text: बुलाइ लीन्हि घरमाहिं, लेइके उछंग तिये
children.translated_text: called her into the house, taking her

children.text: धर्महिं सिखावती । शङ्कर कमलपद करिहो
children.translated_text: into her lap, she teaches her the duties of a wife. 'Worship the lotus feet of

children.text: पूजन नित, पतिहीं के सेवे नारि सर्व सुख
children.translated_text: <s>Śaṅkara</s> daily; a woman who serves her husband alone attains

children.text: पावती ।। तिये धर्म एक पति देव नहिं दूजा
children.translated_text: all happiness. The duty of a wife: one husband alone is the deity, there is no other;

children.text: कोउ, पतिपद पूजा जेहि नारी मन भावती ।
children.translated_text: the woman whose heart delights in worshipping the husband's feet —

children.text: तेहिकहँ दुर्लभ न कछु दुहुँ लोकन में, सब
children.translated_text: for her, nothing is unattainable in either world; in every way,

children.text: बिधि सोइ बरभागिनी कहावती ३९ ।। सवैया ।।
children.translated_text: she alone is called most fortunate.' 39. // <s>Savaiyā</s> (meter) //

children.text: सिखदेइयथोचितमातुउमा, सह प्रेमलगाइ
children.translated_text: Having given appropriate instruction, the mother to <s>Umā</s>, with love embraced

children.text: पुनी उरमाहीं । बिलखी भरि बारि बिलोच-
children.translated_text: her again to her bosom. Weeping, eyes brimming

children.text: न में, ह्वइब्याकुल नेहसुता अधिकाहीं ।। क-
children.translated_text: with tears, she becomes distressed, her affection for her daughter exceeding all bounds.

children.text: हिके करुणामय बैन बहू, उरप्रीति बियोग
children.translated_text: Speaking many words of tenderness, in her heart love and the pain

children.text: बिथा पछिताहीं । बिधि क्यों सिरजे जग में
children.translated_text: of separation [bring] remorse. 'Why did the Creator make

children.text: अबला, परके वश जो सपने सुख नाहीं ४०
children.translated_text: women in this world — subject to others, who have no happiness even in dreams?' 40.

children.text: अतिप्रेम अधीर हुई जननी, उर बारहिंबार
children.translated_text: The mother, overcome with great love, again and again

children.text: सुताहिं लगाई । मिलती बहुरी पदपै पड़-
children.translated_text: clasps her daughter to her bosom. Meeting her and falling at her feet again,

children.text: ती, जल पङ्कज नैनन सों बहि जाई ।। बरनी
children.translated_text: tears flow from her lotus eyes.

children.text: नहिं जाहि दशा तवनी, समुझी कुसमै उर
children.translated_text: Her condition at that time cannot be described; finally, with great difficulty, she gathers

children.text: धीरज लाई । तब जाइ उमा सब नारिन सों,
children.translated_text: courage in her heart. Then <s>Umā</s> goes to all the women,

children.text: मिलि मातु हिये लपटी पुनि आई ४१
children.translated_text: meets them, and clings again to her mother's heart. 41.

children.text: जननीसन भेटि चली गिरिजा, सबसों शुभ
children.translated_text: Having embraced her mother, <s>Girijā</s> departs, having received

children.text: आशिष सुन्दर पाई । फिरि फीरि बिलो-
children.translated_text: beautiful and auspicious blessings from all. Again and again she looks

children.text: कति मातु दिशी, अतिनेह भई हृदये बिक-
children.translated_text: back toward her mother, overcome with great affection and

children.text: लाई ।। कहिजाति नहीं सो बियोगबिथा,
children.translated_text: distress of heart. The pain of that separation

children.text: कठिनी जग प्रीतिकि रीति सदाई । उरधीर
children.translated_text: cannot be told — harsh indeed is the way of worldly love, always.

children.text: धरी सखिलेइ उमा,तब शंकर पास दई पहुँ-
children.translated_text: Bearing courage in her heart, her friends lead <s>Umā</s>; then

children.text: चाई ४२ सब याचकही सनमानि भले, नि-
children.translated_text: she was brought to <s>Śaṅkara</s>'s presence. 42. Honoring all the supplicants well,

children.text: जधाम चले भवसाथ भवानी । हरषी उर
children.translated_text: <s>Bhava</s> (<s>Śiva</s>) departed for his own abode with <s>Bhavānī</s>.

children.text: देवन पुष्प बहू; बरषैं कहि सुन्दरि जयजय
children.translated_text: The gods, delighted in their hearts, shower many flowers,

children.text: बानी ।। नभ दुन्दुभि आदिक भांति कितै,
children.translated_text: uttering beautiful words of 'Victory! Victory!'

children.text: बहुबाजन बाजहिं आनँददानी । हिमवानहुँ
children.translated_text: In the sky, drums (<s>dundubhi</s>) and many kinds of

children.text: साथ चले शिवको, पहुँचावन प्रीति हृद
children.translated_text: instruments play, bestowers of joy. <s>Himavān</s> (the Himalaya) also

children.text: अधिकानी ४३ बहुभांति कही परितष करी,
children.translated_text: went along with <s>Śiva</s>, to escort them, with love overflowing

children.text: गिरिनाथहिंकीन्ह बिदागिरिजेशू । इत आये
children.translated_text: in his heart. 43. Having spoken many words and given much consolation,

children.text: गृही हिमवन्त निजै, गवने उत आपन धाम
children.translated_text: the Lord of Mountains bade farewell to the Lord of <s>Girijā</s> (<s>Śiva</s>). <s>Himavān</s> returned

children.text: महेशु ॥ सब सागर शैल सरादिक जो, रहे
children.translated_text: to his own home; and <s>Maheśa</s> (<s>Śiva</s>) departed for his own abode.

children.text: नेवत आये धरी बहुभेशू । अतिसादर
children.translated_text: All the oceans, mountains, rivers, and others who had come

children.text: कीन्ह गिरीशबिदा, गवने अपने अपने सब
children.translated_text: as invited guests in many guises — with great respect,

children.text: देशु ४४ जबहीं शशिशेखर संगशिव, पहुँचे
children.translated_text: <s>Girīśa</s> bade them farewell, and they all went to their respective

children.text: कयलासहिं जो सुखधामा । उर मोद भरे
children.translated_text: lands. 44. When <s>Śaśiśekhara</s> (the Moon-Crested One, <s>Śiva</s>), with <s>Śivā</s>,

children.text: सब देव गये, अपनो अपनो जहँ जाकर
children.translated_text: arrived at <s>Kailāsa</s>, the abode of happiness, all the joyful gods departed

children.text: ठामा ।। जग मातु पिता शिव पारबती, कय-
children.translated_text: to their own respective places.

children.text: लास रहे जन पूरण कामा । किम ताहि
children.translated_text: The Mother and Father of the world, <s>Śiva</s> and <s>Pārvatī</s>, dwelt at

children.text: शृँगार कथा कहिये, नित भोग बिलास च-
children.translated_text: <s>Kailāsa</s>, fulfilling the desires of their devotees. How can one tell

children.text: रित्र ललामा ४५ हरगौरि बिवाह चरित्र
children.translated_text: the tale of their adornment — the daily enjoyment and amusement, the most excellent conduct? 45. The tale of the marriage of <s>Hara</s> and <s>Gaurī</s>,

children.text: कथा, बहु भांतिन नित्य नवीन उदारा ।
children.translated_text: of many kinds, ever new and generous —

children.text: अवगाह अनंत अगोचरजो, गमनाहिं जहां
children.translated_text: its depth is infinite and beyond perception, where

children.text: मन बुद्धि बिचारा ।। सहसानन बानि न
children.translated_text: neither mind nor intellect nor thought can reach.

children.text: अन्तलहैं, श्रुति जानिसकै नहिं भेद अपारा ।
children.translated_text: Even the thousand-tongued [<s>Śeṣa</s>] cannot find its end; the <s>Vedas</s> cannot know its infinite mysteries.

children.text: किमि सो यह राम औतार कहै, अतिमन्द-
children.translated_text: How can this <s>Rāma</s> incarnation describe it — one of exceedingly dull

children.text: मती अघलीन गँवारा ४६ ।। दोहा ।। शंकर
children.translated_text: intellect, steeped in sin, a rustic? 46. // <s>Dohā</s> (couplet) // <s>Śaṅkara</s>'s

children.text: ब्याह चरित्र शुभ, मुददायक सुखखान ।।
children.translated_text: auspicious wedding tale, bestowing joy, a mine of happiness.

children.text: कहत सुनत शङ्कर शिवा, कृपा परम क-
children.translated_text: In telling and hearing [the tale] of <s>Śaṅkara</s> and <s>Śivā</s>,

children.text: ल्यान १ आश्विन सित तिथि प्रतिपदा,
children.translated_text: [there is] supreme grace and welfare. 1. On the first day of the bright half of <s>Āśvina</s>,

children.text: उदधिसुवनसुतबार ।। संबत १९४९ ग्रह
children.translated_text: on the day [named after] the son of the son of the Ocean [Saturday],

children.text: वेदाङ्क शशि, ग्रन्थ समाप्ति बिचार २ जो
children.translated_text: <s>Saṃvat</s> 1949, [under the stars of] planets, <s>Vedāṅga</s> [6], and moon [1] —

children.text: कुछ दूषण याहिमहँ, देखव सज्जन लोग ।।
children.translated_text: the book is completed, with deliberation. 2. Whatever faults there may be herein,

children.text: देव सुधारि बिचारि उर, तन गुण दोष
children.translated_text: let the good people see. May the gods improve and consider [them] in their hearts,

Dohā: Bowing my head at the lotus-pair of the feet of <s>Śrī Gaṇapati</s>,
